Class Cube

java.lang.Object
com.cooke.shapes.Shape
com.cooke.shapes.ThreeDimensionalShape
com.cooke.shapes.Cube
public class Cube extends ThreeDimensionalShape
Cube Class Creates a Cube object with with a given length; The Cube's volume is calculated when a new Cube is created and when the radius is adjusted. filename: Cube.java creation date: 20261027
